snippet.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Anno 117: Pax Romana is out on November 13! 
Will you govern by power, beauty, efficiency or culture?
Get ready to build your Roman Empire!
 
Begin your journey now 👉 https://store.ubisoft.com/anno-117--pax-romana/6638e5dcaa201a2d55bcc772.html
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274580/Anno_117_Pax_Romana/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011009
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/anno-117-pax-romana/9nfmq8mp7353
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/anno-117-pax-romana


FOLLOW US ON:
Web: anno-union.com
Instagram: @annogame 
Facebook: facebook.com/annogame/
Twitter: twitter.com/ANNO_EN

#Anno117PaxRomana #Anno117 #Anno #Anno117Preorder

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
